Use paired, category-stratified user bootstrap: retain each model’s per-user hit indicator; resample 200 users with replacement within each category using identical indices across models; compute Δ = ¼Σcategory mean(hitA−hitB). Suggested protocol: 10,000 resamples, fixed bootstrap seed, percentile 95% intervals, category deltas and discordant-user counts. Bootstrap the loss×graph interaction, combined−loss−graph+baseline, to assess complementarity. This applies [paired bootstrap principles](https://aclanthology.org/W04-3250/). Intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on trained models and pinned candidates; they exclude training randomness and negative-sampling variability. Sampled rankings need not preserve full-catalog model ordering ([Krichene–Rendle](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/)).

Repeatedly choosing configurations or checkpoints on these same 800 users creates selection optimism; bootstrapping the selected winner does not remove it. [Cawley–Talbot](https://jmlr.csail.mit.edu/papers/v11/cawley10a.html) show selection bias can rival algorithm differences; [Dwork et al.](https://papers.nips.cc/paper_files/paper/2015/hash/bad5f33780c42f2588878a9d07405083-Abstract.html) explain adaptive holdout overfitting. With fixed splits and no untouched evaluation labels, label all validation intervals exploratory. Predeclare contrasts and use simultaneous intervals or Holm-adjusted tests for fixed comparisons; these do not correct an adaptively expanded search.

Suggested budget protocol: freeze the four-arm ablation, seed settings, search spaces, checkpoint schedule, practical improvement threshold and stopping rule before searching. Divide the 43,200 GPU-second budget explicitly, charge failed trials and diagnostics, and log every configuration and validation query. Use equal search allocations per arm and successive halving to concentrate training on promising configurations ([Hyperband](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v18/16-558.html)); preserve all categories and pinned candidates. Freeze finalists before paired analysis, prefer simpler models when gains remain uncertain, and leave confirmation to the host’s held-out evaluation.
